description: A difficult 7.2 km. hike following an old mining trail to alpine. As you reach the sub alpine. The trail splits with an unmarked route leading to the right towards the Nipple and Maroon Peak. The left hand route follows along the north side of the mountain to the remains of old mining claims. Once alpine is reached there are excellent views of Kalum Valley and surrounding ranges.
directions: Follow the Nisga'a Highway (113), north of Terrace, for 34.5 km. Turn right onto the Wesach Creek Road, (1.3 km. north of the Maroon Creek bridge) and follow the signs for the next 3.5 km. A parking area is located at this point, next to Hall Creek. After crossing the creek follow the road to the right for approx. another 1.5 km to the trailhead.
